fields.statement: Model lints in review (change set 01M76XTF): today a failed `rhiza run code-check` ends the review run failed, because the code step has no on.fail. Where should a lint hit go so it saves a review cycle instead of ending the run? / Model lints in review: which capabilities should the stale-reference lint check? It flags repo paths, Go test names and testscript names in a statement or acceptance that do not exist at the branch head. / Model lints in review: how should the lint decide that a Decision was "never applied"?
